claim.purpose: Prepare typed #5337 cards, design, validation, and readiness one dependency wave ahead without implementing the characterization corpus

initial.title: [v0.91.8][WP-03] Build normalized characterization and determinism corpus
initial.goal: Prepare #5337 for a future compact normalized v1 characterization and determinism corpus without executing product scope.
initial.required_outcome: All six current-template cards, issue-local design, validation contract, dependency boundary, and preparation-only readiness truth are complete and reviewed while corpus implementation remains pending on WP-02 and separate authorization.
declared_scope: issue-local typed C-SDLC v2 cards and canonical record for #5337
truthful dependency and non-implementation readiness disposition
authority_boundary: Sprint #5595 authorizes #5337 card preparation in opening-wave slot 2
Issue #5337 owns future WP-03 characterization-corpus implementation
WP-02 #5336 remains the hard implementation dependency
Typed C-SDLC v2 binaries and records are lifecycle authority
initial.task_boundary: Prepare cards, design, validation, review, and readiness only; do not implement fixtures, normalizer behavior, replay execution, product tests, or shared milestone-doc changes.
deliverables: six issue-specific cards rendered from docs/templates/prompts/current.json
PVF-classified preparation and future corpus validation plan
bounded exact-revision subagent review with findings disposition
preparation-only publication or blocked handoff truth
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: SIP, STP, SPP, VPP, SRP, and SOR are generated from the active current.json template set and pass typed schema and structure validation
AC-2: Cards and design preserve #5595 authorization, #5336 dependency, clean-room behavioral-evidence boundaries, and no shared milestone-doc overlap
AC-3: The future corpus contract requires versioned positive and negative cases, repeated outcomes, declared normalization, coverage mapping, and nondeterminism disposition
AC-4: Preparation validation and future corpus proof lanes are PVF-classifiable with proof role, determinism posture, resource profile, and release-gate status
AC-5: Bounded subagent review covers the exact substantive revision and all actionable findings are dispositioned before publication
AC-6: Preparation closes or hands off without claiming corpus implementation, WP-02 satisfaction, milestone readiness, cutover, deletion, or v0.92 activation
dependencies: open sprint umbrella #5595 opening-wave slot 2 authorization
WP-02 #5336 must be accepted before future product implementation
repo_inputs: GitHub sprint issue #5595 retrieved through adl-issue
non_goals: no corpus fixtures, normalizer code, replay execution, or product tests
no porting of legacy internal tests
no shared milestone planning or feature-document edits
no downstream implementation binding or claim-path reservation
no AWS, raw gh, Runtime/C-SDLC implementation, deletion, cutover, or v0.92 activation
initial.plan_summary: Initialize and bind #5337, verify and semantically normalize all six generated cards, validate current-template and PVF truth, commit issue-local preparation artifacts, run bounded exact-revision subagent review, fix findings, and publish only if the typed lifecycle accepts a preparation-only boundary.

steps.action: Initialize and bind the issue-local typed lifecycle record in the dedicated #5337 worktree
Validate and, only through csdlc-edit, normalize six current-template cards for preparation-only truth
Run focused typed validation and confirm protected-path and dependency boundaries
Commit the substantive preparation revision and run bounded exact-revision subagent review
Record findings disposition and publish or retain a truthful blocked preparation handoff through typed lifecycle gates

risks: preparation language could be mistaken for authorization to implement the corpus
overbroad protected paths could collide with shared milestone documentation or sibling lanes
normalization rules could hide semantic mismatches if left unconstrained
generated cards could remain generic while passing only superficial structure checks
invariants: no tracked issue work on main
all card mutation remains csdlc-edit owned
only issue-local preparation paths are protected
v1 is behavioral evidence rather than source authority
no AWS and no raw gh
stop_conditions: another live claim or worktree owns #5337
WP-03 preparation would require shared milestone-doc edits
a lifecycle route would record product implementation or dependency satisfaction
current-template provenance or typed card validation cannot be established
publication would require bypassing current review truth
review_prompts: Do all six cards and the design remain preparation-only and issue-specific?
Is #5336 preserved as a hard implementation dependency while #5595 authorizes only card preparation?
Does the future corpus contract cover positive and negative behavior, repetition, normalization, coverage, and nondeterminism without implementing them?
Are protected paths issue-local and collision-safe with shared milestone and sibling work?
Are PVF lanes and non-claims sufficient for a truthful preparation handoff?

validation_lanes.proof_role: Validate all six rendered cards, active-template provenance, structure schemas, and canonical lifecycle consistency
Verify preparation diff hygiene and absence of shared milestone or product implementation changes
Verify that bounded subagent review is assigned to the substantive commit and that actionable findings have typed dispositions before publication
Future implementation lane for versioned positive and negative fixtures, repeated v1 outcomes, normalization safety, coverage mapping, and nondeterminism disposition
validation_lanes.defer_reason: Product implementation and its focused proof are not authorized in this preparation-only session

initial.failure_policy: Fail closed on non-current template provenance, invalid cards, generic or implementation-claiming prose, shared-path overlap, missing #5336 dependency, hidden normalization, skipped review, AWS/raw-gh use, or any product-scope execution.
